rationale: Model-controlled tool execution reaches hardened_command in the enforced sandbox (bee-harness/src/tools/bash.rs:43-52; bee-harness/src/sandbox.rs:164-190). Its pre-exec hardening disables dumps but never drops UID/GID/capabilities or sets no_new_privs (bee-userspace/src/spawn.rs:92-97; bee-hardening/src/lib.rs:29-32), so a privileged loader spawns privileged tools.
